schema: CREATE TABLE member ( member_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, first_name TEXT, last_name TEXT ); CREATE TABLE expense ( expense_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, cost REAL, link_to_member TEXT, FOREIGN KEY (link_to_member) REFERENCES member(member_id) );
correct_query: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name, SUM(T2.cost) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN expense AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member;

expected_mutants_to_kill.query: SELECT member.first_name, member.last_name, SUM(expense.cost) AS total_cost FROM member INNER JOIN expense ON member.member_id = expense.link_to_member GROUP BY member.first_name, member.last_name;
